sloka: एवम् निष्फलम् आरब्धम् केवल अनर्थ सम्हितम् ।न कश्चित् साधु मन्येत यथैव गुरु तल्पगम् ॥२-६३-३२॥
transliteration: evam niṣphalam ārabdham kevala anartha samhitam ।na kaścit sādhu manyeta yathaiva guru talpagam ॥2-63-32॥

translations.english: 'Whoever it is, he has committed only a mischievous and senseless act. This sin like a disciple sleeping on the bed of his preceptor none will approve of.
